units.source_text: 突然，他脱口尖叫了一声，连他自己对那叫声也感到吃惊，女人更是一副吃惊纳闷的表情，回过头来。

en.t: Suddenly, he let out a sharp cry before he could stop himself, and even he was startled by the sound; the woman, looking even more surprised and puzzled, turned back toward him.

units.source_text: 原来，自己还没有彻头彻尾地成为蝼蚁……

en.t: So he had not yet become an insect through and through after all...
